title: DOW-UAP-D58, Range Fouler Debrief, NA, October 2020
doc_notes: This document is a U.S. Navy Range Fouler Debrief form detailing an encounter with two unidentified aerial phenomena, containing redactions under 1.4(a).

incidents.summary: U.S. Navy pilot reported two balloon-shaped, metallic, reflective UAP displaying red blinking strobes and noise jamming.
incidents.quote: ONE RANGE FOULER WAS CIRCLING AROUND THE OTHER. IN 1/30TH OF A SECOND, THEY WERE GONE.
